```c
sensor_status_t mark_detector_read(int32_t *value_q16)
{
    uint8_t dummy, v;
    sensor_status_t st = isl_setup();
    if (st != SENSOR_OK)
        return st;
    if (!isl_read_reg(ISL_REG_CH_A - 1, &dummy))   // read 0x09 before 0x0A
        return SENSOR_TIMEOUT;
    if (!isl_read_reg(ISL_REG_CH_A, &v))
        return SENSOR_TIMEOUT;
    *value_q16 = (int32_t)v << 8;
    return SENSOR_OK;
}
```

    int32_t start, slot, peak;
    int32_t refl;
    int32_t scan_steps;
    int32_t z2_start;
    int32_t prev_a;
    uint32_t frozen;
    uint8_t found_slot, found_index;

    if (!ctx->blade_raised())
        return A_HOME_ERR_BLADE_DOWN;

    start = ctx->read_a_steps();
    z2_start = ctx->read_z2_steps();

    slot = 0;
    peak = 0;
    found_slot = 0;
    found_index = 0;
    frozen = 0;
    prev_a = start;

    while (1)
    {
        if (ctx->abort())
            return A_HOME_ERR_ABORT;

        /* Drift check: Z2 must stay at top stall. */
        if (abs(ctx->read_z2_steps() - z2_start) > A_HOME_Z2_DZ_TOL)
            return A_HOME_ERR_DRIFT;

        refl = ctx->read_refl();
        if (refl < 0)
            return A_HOME_ERR_FAULT;

        if (!found_slot) {
            if (refl < A_HOME_SLOT_REFL) {
                slot = ctx->read_a_steps();
                found_slot = 1;
                continue;
            }
            /* Scan for slot. */
            scan_steps = ctx->read_a_steps() - start;
            if (scan_steps < 0) scan_steps = -scan_steps;
            if (scan_steps > A_HOME_SCAN_MAX)
                return A_HOME_ERR_NOTRANS;
        }
        else if (!found_index) {
            if (refl > A_HOME_INDEX_REFL) {
                int32_t a = ctx->read_a_steps();
                int32_t d = a - slot;
                if (d < 0) d = -d;
                if (d >= A_HOME_SLOT_TO_INDEX) {
                    peak = a;
                    found_index = 1;
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        else {
            /* On the index: track peak, detect trailing edge. */
            if (refl > A_HOME_INDEX_REFL) {
                peak = ctx->read_a_steps();
            } else {
                /* trailing edge passed; home = peak */
                *home_steps = peak;
                return A_HOME_OK;
            }
        }

        /* Pulse. */
        prev_a = ctx->read_a_steps();
        ctx->pulse(1, found_index ? A_HOME_FINE_PULSE_MS : A_HOME_PULSE_MS);

        /* Latch check: encoder must advance. */
        if (ctx->read_a_steps() == prev_a) {
            frozen++;
            if (frozen >= A_HOME_LATCH_LIMIT)
                return A_HOME_ERR_LATCH;
        } else {
            frozen = 0;
        }
    }
}

The loop:

```c
a_home_result_t a_home_run(const a_home_ctx_t *ctx, int32_t *home_steps)
{
    int32_t start, slot, peak;
    int32_t refl, a;
    int32_t z2_start;
    int32_t prev_a;
    uint32_t frozen;
    uint8_t phase;   /* 0=scan, 1=index-seek, 2=peak-track */

    if (!ctx->blade_raised())
        return A_HOME_ERR_BLADE_DOWN;

    start = ctx->read_a_steps();
    z2_start = ctx->read_z2_steps();

    slot = 0;
    peak = 0;
    phase = 0;
    frozen = 0;
    prev_a = start;

    for (;;)
    {
        if (ctx->abort())
            return A_HOME_ERR_ABORT;

        if (ah_abs(ctx->read_z2_steps() - z2_start) > A_HOME_Z2_DZ_TOL)
            return A_HOME_ERR_DRIFT;

        refl = ctx->read_refl();
        if (refl < 0)
            return A_HOME_ERR_FAULT;

        a = ctx->read_a_steps();

        if (phase == 0)
        {
            if (refl < A_HOME_SLOT_REFL)
            {
                slot = a;
                phase = 1;
            }
            else if (ah_abs(a - start) > A_HOME_SCAN_MAX_STEPS)
            {
                return A_HOME_ERR_NOTRANS;
            }
        }
        else if (phase == 1)
        {
            if (refl > A_HOME_INDEX_REFL && ah_abs(a - slot) >= A_HOME_SLOT_TO_INDEX)
            {
                peak = a;
                phase = 2;
            }
        }
        else /* phase == 2 */
        {
            if (refl > A_HOME_INDEX_REFL)
            {
                peak = a;
            }
            else
            {
                *home_steps = peak;
                return A_HOME_OK;
            }
        }

        /* Pulse A forward and verify the encoder advanced (latch guard). */
        prev_a = ctx->read_a_steps();
        ctx->pulse(1, (phase == 2) ? A_HOME_FINE_PULSE_MS : A_HOME_COARSE_PULSE_MS);

        if (ctx->read_a_steps() == prev_a)
        {
            frozen++;
            if (frozen >= A_HOME_LATCH_LIMIT)
                return A_HOME_ERR_LATCH;
        }
        else
        {
            frozen = 0;
        }
    }
}
```

```c
// z2_endstop.h
#ifndef __INC_HAL_Z2_ENDSTOP_H
#define __INC_HAL_Z2_ENDSTOP_H
#include <stdint.h>
/* Drive Z2 up (CW) to its top stall and verify it's parked (dz <= tol). */
uint8_t z2_endstop_raise(void);
#endif
```

```c
// z2_endstop.c
#include "hal/z2_endstop.h"
#include "hal/motor.h"
#include "grbl/grbl/nuts_bolts.h"   // delay_ms

#define Z2_RAISE_SPEED      1800
#define Z2_RAISE_MS         1500    // bounded raise jog (covers ~7000 steps)
#define Z2_VERIFY_MS        200     // short verification jog
#define Z2_STALL_DZ_TOL     150

static int32_t z2_steps(void) { return HAL_MOTOR_Z2.current_steps; }

static void z2_jog(int32_t dir, uint32_t ms)
{
    hal_motor_set_manual(&HAL_MOTOR_Z2, true);
    hal_motor_set_speed(&HAL_MOTOR_Z2, Z2_RAISE_SPEED);
    hal_motor_set_direction(&HAL_MOTOR_Z2, dir);
    delay_ms((uint16_t)ms);
    hal_motor_set_direction(&HAL_MOTOR_Z2, HAL_MOTOR_STOP);
    hal_motor_set_manual(&HAL_MOTOR_Z2, false);
}

static uint8_t z2_stalled(void)
{
    int32_t before = z2_steps();
    z2_jog(HAL_MOTOR_DIR_CW, Z2_VERIFY_MS);
    int32_t after = z2_steps();
    int32_t dz = after - before;
    if (dz < 0) dz = -dz;
    return dz <= Z2_STALL_DZ_TOL;
}

uint8_t z2_endstop_raise(void)
{
    z2_jog(HAL_MOTOR_DIR_CW, Z2_RAISE_MS);   // raise toward top
    return z2_stalled();
}
```

uint8_t z2_endstop_raise(void)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < Z2_RAISE_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
        int32_t before = z2_steps();
        z2_jog(CW, Z2_RAISE_CHUNK_MS);
        int32_t dz = z2_steps() - before;
        if (dz < 0) dz = -dz;

    return 0;
}

static uint8_t z2_to_stall(int32_t dir) {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < Z2_RAISE_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
        int32_t before = z2_steps();
        int32_t dz;
        z2_jog(dir, Z2_RAISE_CHUNK_MS);
        dz = z2_steps() - before;
        if (dz < 0) dz = -dz;
        if (dz <= Z2_STALL_DZ_TOL) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

}

/**
 * A-axis absolute homing state machine (pure logic; see a_home.h).
 */

#include "hal/a_home.h"

/* Reflectance signature thresholds (session-4 calibration + on-machine sweep;
 * tune on-machine). */
#define A_HOME_SLOT_REFL        30
#define A_HOME_INDEX_REFL       70

/* Geometry (encoder steps). */
#define A_HOME_SLOT_TO_INDEX    3500
#define A_HOME_STEPS_PER_REV    17350
#define A_HOME_SCAN_MAX_STEPS   (A_HOME_STEPS_PER_REV + A_HOME_STEPS_PER_REV / 2)

/* Chamfer discrimination: the wide chamfer (5.14 mm) spans ~55.7 deg (~2685
 * steps), the narrow one (<=4 mm) <= ~42.7 deg (~2055 steps). A peak narrower
 * than this is the narrow chamfer and is skipped. */
#define A_HOME_WIDE_MIN_STEPS   2370

/* Pulse timing. ... */
#define A_HOME_PULSE_MS         150
#define A_HOME_FINE_PULSE_MS    100

/* Safety. */
#define A_HOME_Z2_DZ_TOL        500
#define A_HOME_LATCH_LIMIT      5

enum {
    A_HOME_PHASE_SCAN = 0,    /* find slot */
    A_HOME_PHASE_SEEK = 1,    /* find peak start after slot */
    A_HOME_PHASE_MEASURE = 2  /* measure peak width, discriminate */
};

And the loop:
```c
a_home_result_t a_home_run(const a_home_ctx_t *ctx, int32_t *home_steps)
{
    int32_t start;
    int32_t slot = 0;
    int32_t peak_start = 0;
    int32_t peak_end = 0;
    int32_t z2_start;
    int32_t prev_a;
    int32_t refl;
    int32_t a;
    uint8_t phase = A_HOME_PHASE_SCAN;
    uint32_t frozen = 0;

    start = ctx->read_a_steps();
    z2_start = ctx->read_z2_steps();
    prev_a = start;

    for (;;)
    {
        if (ctx->abort())
            return A_HOME_ERR_ABORT;

        if (ah_abs(ctx->read_z2_steps() - z2_start) > A_HOME_Z2_DZ_TOL)
        {
            ga_drift = ctx->read_z2_steps() - z2_start;
            return A_HOME_ERR_DRIFT;
        }

        refl = ctx->read_refl();
        if (refl < 0)
            return A_HOME_ERR_FAULT;

        a = ctx->read_a_steps();

        switch (phase)
        {
        case A_HOME_PHASE_SCAN:
            if (refl < A_HOME_SLOT_REFL)
            {
                slot = a;
                phase = A_HOME_PHASE_SEEK;
            }
            else if (ah_abs(a - start) > A_HOME_SCAN_MAX_STEPS)
            {
                return A_HOME_ERR_NOTRANS;
            }
            break;

        case A_HOME_PHASE_SEEK:
            if ((refl > A_HOME_INDEX_REFL) &&
                (ah_abs(a - slot) >= A_HOME_SLOT_TO_INDEX))
            {
                peak_start = a;
                peak_end = a;
                phase = A_HOME_PHASE_MEASURE;
            }
            else if (ah_abs(a - start) > A_HOME_SCAN_MAX_STEPS)
            {
                return A_HOME_ERR_NOTRANS;
            }
            break;

        case A_HOME_PHASE_MEASURE:
            if (refl > A_HOME_INDEX_REFL)
            {
                peak_end = a;
            }
            else
            {
                int32_t width = peak_end - peak_start;

                if (width >= A_HOME_WIDE_MIN_STEPS)
                {
                    *home_steps = peak_start + width / 2;
                    return A_HOME_OK;
                }
                /* Narrow chamfer: skip it, look for the next slot + peak. */
                slot = 0;
                phase = A_HOME_PHASE_SCAN;
            }
            break;
        }

        /* Pulse A forward, then verify the encoder advanced (latch guard). */
        prev_a = ctx->read_a_steps();
        ctx->pulse(1, (phase == A_HOME_PHASE_MEASURE)
                        ? A_HOME_FINE_PULSE_MS : A_HOME_PULSE_MS);

        if (ctx->read_a_steps() == prev_a)
        {
            frozen++;
            if (frozen >= A_HOME_LATCH_LIMIT)
                return A_HOME_ERR_LATCH;
        }
        else
        {
            frozen = 0;
        }
    }
}
```
